start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj Perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya interesting lagta hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunkar lag raha hai ki aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi theek hain?
Theek hai, Kabir. Aapko hamesha bata sakte hain agar kuch pareshaan kare. Chaliye: vegetable patch ko fence karne mein hum kya naapenge—andar ka area ya bahar ki boundary?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Bilkul, Kabir— aapne rectangle ki chaaron sides jodkar perimeter 160 metre nikala. Square mein sides kaise jodenge?
